acceptedAnswer.text: Admission to BVP B.Tech is through JEE Main exam followed by GGSIPU counselling process. Students need to appear for JEE Main, register on the GGSIPU portal, and participate in the centralized counselling to lock their seat. Call us at 9899991342 for step-by-step guidance.

mainEntity.name: What B.Tech programs does BVP offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: BVP offers B.Tech programs in Computer Science Engineering (CSE), Information Technology (IT), and Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), along with BJMC and MCA programs.

mainEntity.name: Is management quota available at BVP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, BVP offers Management Quota seats for B.Tech as per GGSIPU regulations. mainEntity.name: What is management seat / management quota in IP University?

acceptedAnswer.text: Management seat (also called management quota) in IP University (GGSIPU) refers to a limited percentage of seats in private affiliated colleges that are filled directly by the institute outside centralised counselling. These seats are regulated by university and Delhi Government policies. Valid entrance score (JEE Main / CUET / CLAT) and course eligibility are still required.

mainEntity.name: Is management seat the same as management quota in IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — management seat and management quota refer to the same admission category in IP University (GGSIPU). Both terms describe seats in private affiliated colleges filled directly, outside the centralised counselling process, subject to eligibility and university verification.

mainEntity.name: Do I need JEE Main for management quota in IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: For B.Tech management quota seats under IP University, a valid JEE Main score is generally required to meet basic eligibility. However, the exact requirement may vary by college. Management quota does not bypass eligibility — it bypasses centralised counselling rank-based allotment.

mainEntity.name: Which IPU colleges offer management quota seats?

acceptedAnswer.text: Private affiliated colleges like MAIT, MSIT, BPIT, Bharati Vidyapeeth, VIPS, ADGITM, GTBIT and HMRITM offer management quota seats. Government institutes like USICT do not offer management quota.

mainEntity.name: Is management quota admission legal in IP University?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, management quota admission is a legitimate and regulated process in IP University. Final admission requires university verification and approval. Admissions without proper eligibility or documents are not valid.

mainEntity.name: Which colleges offer B.Tech under IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per the GGSIPU UG Admission Brochure 2026-27 (Chapter 13), B.Tech is offered at 4 University Schools of Studies (USS) on the IPU Dwarka campus — USIC&T (CSE/IT/ECE/CSE-AI/CSE-DS as B.Tech-M.Tech Dual Degree), USAR (CSE-AI&DS / AI&ML / IIOT / Robotics & Automation), USCT (Chemical Engineering / Energy) and USBT (Biotechnology) — and across 20+ affiliated engineering colleges including MAIT Rohini, MSIT Janakpuri, BPIT Rohini, BVP Paschim Vihar, ADGITM (formerly ADGITM/ADGIPS) Shastri Park, GTBIT Rajouri Garden, GTB 4th Centenary Engineering College, HMR IT&M, JEMTEC Greater Noida, DTC Greater Noida, JIMS Engineering Greater Noida, Trinity Greater Noida, VIPS-TC Pitampura, DIST, Echelon Faridabad, Greater Noida Inst of Tech, Shri Balwant Sonipat, and Tribhuvan College Neemrana.

mainEntity.name: How many B.Tech seats does IPU offer in total?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 2026-27 brochure shows roughly 11,000+ B.Tech seats across IPU colleges (Shift 1 + Shift 2, all specialisations). USS on-campus alone offers ~720 seats (USICT 540 + USAR 528 across 4 dual-degree programmes + USCT 180). Echelon Faridabad has the largest single-college intake (~1,000+ across 14 specialisations). Final sanctioned intake for 2026-27 is notified on ipu.ac.in before counselling.

mainEntity.name: What is the B.Tech fee at the IPU campus (USS) 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Part E, Chapter 14 of the brochure, B.Tech fee at USIC&T / USAR / USCT for 2026-27 is: tuition Rs. 1,69,400 + university charges Rs. 20,000 + alumni one-time Rs. 2,000 + exam Rs. 3,000 + innovation Rs. 500 + infrastructure Rs. 10,000 = Rs. 2,04,900 (Year 1 total). Year 2: Rs. 2,19,840. Year 3: Rs. 2,38,474. Year 4: Rs. 2,58,971.

mainEntity.name: What is the B.Tech fee at IPU affiliated colleges (MAIT/MSIT/BPIT)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Affiliated colleges publish SFRC-recommended fees every year: for 2026-27, first-year B.Tech tuition is Rs. 1,60,100 to Rs. 1,65,770 at BPIT, BVCOE and ADGIPS (the 14.07.2025 SFRC gazette range was Rs. 1,41,750 to Rs. 1,55,700), plus university charges, exam fee, innovation fee, alumni and welfare contributions. First-year totals are about Rs. 2,02,270 at BPIT and Rs. 2,12,270 at BVCOE.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for IPU B.Tech admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: Class 12 (10+2) pass with Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics (PCM), minimum 55% aggregate (50% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD). Admission is through JEE Main primary merit followed by centralised online counselling at ipu.ac.in. CUET may apply for vacant-seat filling per Important Instruction #37 of the 2026-27 brochure. Marks are not rounded off (Instruction #28).

mainEntity.name: Which IPU college offers the most B.Tech specialisations 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Echelon Institute of Technology, Faridabad offers the widest B.Tech menu in IPU per Chapter 13 — 14 specialisations including CSE, ECE, ME, Civil, AI&ML, AI&DS, CSE-Cyber Security, CSE-IOT & Blockchain, Robotics & AI, 3D Modelling & Animation, Architecture & Interior Decoration, Nanoscience & Technology, and Mechatronics. MAIT Rohini also offers 14 specialisations across IT, CSE, ECE, EEE, ME, CST, CSE-AI/AI&ML/DS and Electronics-VLSI/Advanced Communication.

mainEntity.name: How do I apply for IPU B.Tech admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apply through GGSIPU online counselling once JEE Main 2026 result is declared. Register on the official portal (ipu.admissions.nic.in), pay the counselling fee, lock your college and branch choices, and await seat allotment. The 2026 counselling process typically opens in the third-fourth week of July. Free step-by-step application help: call 9899991342.

mainEntity.name: Is there a management quota for IPU B.Tech admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, select private affiliated colleges under IPU offer 15-20% seats under the management quota for candidates with lower JEE Main ranks. Fee for management quota is significantly higher than the regular seat (typically 1.5-2x). Seats are limited and fill quickly during counselling. For current management-quota seat availability across IPU colleges, call 9899991342 or see our management-quota guide.

mainEntity.name: What are IPU B.Tech fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: At USICT (the university school), IPU B.Tech tuition is Rs. 1,69,400 - 2,25,471 per year (GGSIPU Admission Brochure 2026-27 and 6th SFRC notification). Affiliated colleges publish SFRC-recommended fees every year: for 2026-27, BPIT and BVCOE list first-year B.Tech tuition of Rs. 1,65,770 in their own fee notices, and total first-year payments are higher once university and other charges are added. See the IPU fee structure.

mainEntity.name: What is the B.Tech cutoff for IPU colleges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Closing ranks differ by college, branch and round. See the IPU B.Tech cutoff page for round-wise JEE Main ranks.

B.Tech admission at Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU / IP University) is offered for 2026-27 at four on-campus University Schools of Studies (USIC&T, USAR, USCT, USBT — combined ~720 seats including B.Tech-M.Tech Dual Degree programmes) and across 20+ affiliated engineering colleges in Delhi NCR with a combined intake of approximately 11,000+ seats. The largest single-college intake is at Echelon Institute Faridabad (~1,000 seats across 14 specialisations) followed by MAIT Rohini (~900 across 14 specialisations). Admission is through JEE Main primary merit followed by centralised online counselling at ipu.ac.in; CUET applies for vacant-seat filling. USS tuition is Rs. 1,69,400/year (total Rs. 2,04,900/year incl. all charges); affiliated colleges charge Rs. 1,60,100-1,65,770 tuition in year 1 of 2026-27 per their own fee notices (the 14.07.2025 SFRC gazette range was Rs. 1,41,750 to Rs. 1,55,700). Eligibility: Class 12 with PCM, min 55% (50% reserved). For free admission counselling call 9899991342.

mainEntity.name: Which colleges offer BA-LLB and BBA-LLB under IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per the GGSIPU UG Admission Brochure 2026-27 (Chapter 13), integrated 5-year law programmes are offered at the University School of Law & Legal Studies (USL&LS, on-campus) and across 12+ affiliated colleges including VIPS-TC Pitampura (BA-LLB 300 + BBA-LLB 240), Fairfield Bijwasan (BA-LLB 200 + BBA-LLB 120), Delhi Metropolitan Education Noida (BA-LLB 180 + BBA-LLB 120), MAIMS Rohini (BA-LLB 180 + BBA-LLB 120), Chanderprabhu Jain Narela (BA-LLB 180 + BBA-LLB 90), KCC Greater Noida (BA-LLB 120 + BBA-LLB 60), Gitarattan IBS Rohini (120+120), ADGITM Shastri Park (60+60), JEMTEC Greater Noida (60+60), Maharaja Surajmal Institute Janakpuri (60+60), Ideal Karkardooma (BA-LLB 80), Trinity Greater Noida (BA-LLB 60), Trinity Dwarka (BA-LLB 60).

mainEntity.name: How many integrated law (BA-LLB / BBA-LLB) seats does IPU offer 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 2026-27 brochure shows roughly 2,400+ integrated law seats across IPU — about 1,500+ BA-LLB (Hons.) and 900+ BBA-LLB (Hons.). USL&LS on-campus offers 120 BA-LLB + 60 BBA-LLB. VIPS-TC Pitampura is the single largest with 540 seats (BA-LLB 300 + BBA-LLB 240). Final sanctioned intake is notified on ipu.ac.in before counselling.

mainEntity.name: What is the law fee at the IPU campus (USL&LS) 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Part E, Chapter 14 of the brochure, BA-LLB / BBA-LLB at USL&LS for 2026-27 is: tuition Rs. 1,45,200 + university charges Rs. 20,000 + alumni one-time Rs. 2,000 + exam Rs. 3,000 + innovation Rs. 500 + infrastructure Rs. 10,000 = Rs. 1,80,700 (Year 1 total). Year 2: Rs. 1,93,220. Year 3: Rs. 2,09,192. Year 4: Rs. 2,26,761. Year 5: Rs. 2,46,087.

mainEntity.name: What is the law fee at IPU affiliated colleges 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Affiliated colleges charge per the 6th SFRC Delhi Gazette Notification dated 14.07.2025 — typically Rs. 1,15,000 to Rs. 1,55,000 per year tuition for BA-LLB / BBA-LLB. Add Rs. 25,000-30,000 in university charges, exam, innovation, alumni and welfare contributions. Total annual cost ~Rs. 1,40,000-1,80,000 at most affiliated colleges (VIPS, MAIMS, Fairfield, DME, Gitarattan).

mainEntity.name: Does IPU also offer LLB (3-year) and LLM?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Per the 2026-27 brochure: 3-year LLB is offered at USL&LS (60 seats), VIPS-TC Pitampura (30 seats) and Chanderprabhu Jain Narela (60 seats) — total fee at USS Rs. 1,80,700/year. 1-year LLM is offered at USL&LS (4 specialisations × 30 seats: Corporate Law, Criminal Justice, IPR, ADR) and 12+ affiliated colleges including MAIMS, VIPS, DIST, Fairfield, Gitarattan, Ideal, KCC and JEMTEC. LLM admission is through IPU CET (LLM).

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for BA-LLB and BBA-LLB at IPU 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Class 12 (10+2) pass with minimum 50% aggregate from a recognised board (45% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD), with English as a compulsory subject. Maximum age 22 years (24 for SC/ST/OBC) per BCI rules. Admission is through CUET (UG) or CLAT (where applicable) followed by centralised online counselling at ipu.ac.in. Marks are not rounded off (Important Instruction #28).

mainEntity.name: What is the IPU law admission process for 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: 5-step process: (1) Appear for CLAT 2026 (for BA-LLB/BBA-LLB) or graduation completion (for 3-year LLB). (2) Get CLAT rank or apply directly via IPU CET-Law. (3) Register for GGSIPU online counselling once it opens at ipu.admissions.nic.in. (4) Pay counselling fee, fill college and branch choices, lock by deadline. (5) Accept Round 1 seat allotment and report to allotted college with documents and tuition fee within the reporting window. Round 2 and 3 follow for vacant seats. Call 9899991342 for the latest dates.

mainEntity.name: Is there management quota for IPU law colleges?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, select private affiliated law colleges under IPU offer 15-20% seats under the management quota for candidates with lower CLAT ranks. Fee for management quota is significantly higher than the regular seat (typically 1.5-2x). Seats are limited and fill quickly during counselling. Call 9899991342 for current management-quota seat availability.

mainEntity.name: Which is the best law college under IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: USLLS (University School of Law and Legal Studies, the university's own on-campus school in Dwarka) is the most reputed law school under GGSIPU with the lowest fee. Among private affiliated colleges, VIPS-TC Pitampura and MAIMS Rohini are highly ranked for placements and intake. Fairfield Bijwasan and Ideal Karkardooma are strong alternatives for mid-rank CLAT scorers. Call 9899991342 for college-fit consultation.

mainEntity.name: What are IPU law college fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: At USLLS (the university school), BA LLB / BBA LLB (5-year) tuition is Rs. 1,45,200 - 2,12,587 per year, about Rs. 8.9 lakh in total, and the 3-year LLB is Rs. 1,45,200 in year 1, rising to Rs. 2,09,192 in year 3 (PG Brochure 2026-27, Section 14.1(F)). Affiliated law colleges have their own SFRC-regulated fees. See the IPU fee structure.

mainEntity.name: What is the fee for BA LLB under Management Quota at IPU?

mainEntity.name: Is CLAT score required for BA LLB Management Quota at IPU?

mainEntity.name: What is Management Quota in IPU B.Tech?

acceptedAnswer.text: Management Quota in IPU B.Tech refers to seats reserved for direct admission by the college management. These seats are filled without going through the regular GGSIPU counselling process based on JEE Main or CUET scores.

mainEntity.name: How many Management Quota seats are available for B.Tech at IPU colleges?

acceptedAnswer.text: 10% of the total seats in IPU affiliated B.Tech colleges are reserved as Management Quota per Section 12(1)(a) of the Delhi Professional Colleges Act, 2007 (Chapter 12 of the GGSIPU Brochure 2026-27). University Schools (USS), minority and government institutions are excluded.

mainEntity.name: What is the fee for B.Tech under Management Quota at IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Management Quota tuition is the same as merit seats — regulated by the Govt of NCT Delhi 6th SFRC Notification dated 14.07.2025 (Appendix 13(i) of the GGSIPU Brochure 2026-27): the brochure range was approximately Rs. 1,41,750 to Rs. 1,55,700 per year, and affiliated colleges' own 2026-27 fee notices show year-1 B.Tech tuition of Rs. 1,60,100 to Rs. 1,65,770 (BPIT, BVCOE, ADGIPS). Capitation fee is prohibited per Section 12 of the Delhi Professional Colleges Act 2007. An additional Rs. 2,500 registration fee applies per Chapter 12.

mainEntity.name: How to apply for B.Tech Management Quota at IP University?

acceptedAnswer.text: To apply for B.Tech Management Quota at IP University, contact the college directly or call the helpline at 9899991342. The process involves submitting an application, attending a counselling session with the college, and paying the required fee.

mainEntity.name: Which colleges offer BBA under IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per the GGSIPU UG Admission Brochure 2026-27 (Chapter 13), BBA is offered at the University School of Management Studies (USMS, on-campus) and across 40+ affiliated colleges including VIPS Pitampura (180+180), MAIMS Rohini (240+180), Maharaja Surajmal Institute Janakpuri (180+180 + BBA B&I 60+60), Delhi Metropolitan Education Noida (180+120), Gitarattan IBS Rohini (180+180), Rukmini Devi Rohini (180+180), MERI Janakpuri, IITM Janakpuri, JIMS Rohini/Kalkaji/Vasant Kunj, Trinity Dwarka, Tecnia Rohini, NDIM Tughlakabad, KCC Greater Noida (240), Don Bosco Okhla, DSPSR Rohini, Lingayas, Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan, MBS Dwarka, JEMTEC Greater Noida, Sant Hari Dass, Kasturi Ram and Echelon Faridabad (BBA + BBA Digital Marketing + BBA Financial Services).

mainEntity.name: How many BBA seats does IPU offer in total 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 2026-27 brochure shows roughly 5,500+ BBA seats across IPU colleges (Shift 1 + Shift 2 combined). The largest single intake is at MAIMS Rohini (420 — 240 Shift 1 + 180 Shift 2) followed by VIPS Pitampura (360) and Maharaja Surajmal Institute Janakpuri (360 + 120 BBA B&I). USMS on-campus offers 60 BBA seats. Final sanctioned intake is notified on ipu.ac.in before counselling.

mainEntity.name: What is the BBA fee at IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: At USMS (university campus) the 2026-27 tuition is Rs. 1,21,000/year, total Rs. 1,56,500/year incl. university charges (Rs. 20,000) + exam (Rs. 3,000) + innovation (Rs. 500) + infrastructure (Rs. 10,000) + alumni one-time (Rs. 2,000) per Part E, Chapter 14. Affiliated colleges charge per the 6th SFRC Delhi Gazette Notification dated 14.07.2025 — typically Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 1,30,000 per year. Add Rs. 25,000-30,000 in university charges per year.

mainEntity.name: Is GGSIPU CET or CUET required for BBA admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: For 2026-27, BBA admission priority per UG Brochure 2026-27 Table 1.1 (Code 125) is 1. GGSIPU CET (primary) / 2. CUET# (vacant-seat fallback per Important Instruction #37), followed by centralised online counselling at ipu.ac.in. Candidates should appear in BOTH — CET first, CUET fills any unfilled seats. 10% Management Quota seats are reserved at every unaided affiliated BBA college per Chapter 12 of the GGSIPU Brochure 2026-27 (Section 12(1)(a) DPCI Rules 2007). Call 9899991342 for free guidance.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for BBA at IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Class 12 (10+2) pass with minimum 50% aggregate from a recognised board (45% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD), with English as a compulsory subject. Per Important Instruction #28 of the 2026-27 brochure, marks are not rounded off — 49.99% does not become 50%.

mainEntity.name: Does IPU offer specialised BBA programmes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — beyond general BBA, the 2026-27 brochure lists BBA (B&I = Banking & Insurance) at MSI Janakpuri and SGTBIMIT, BBA (CAM = Computer Aided Management) at CPJ Narela, BBA-MBA Integrated 5-yr at Gitarattan IBS, and BBA (Digital Marketing) + BBA (Financial Services) at Echelon Institute, Faridabad. There are also Integrated BBA-LLB (Hons.) 5-year programmes at 12+ colleges.

mainEntity.name: What is the IPU BBA fees per year in 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: IPU BBA annual tuition ranges from Rs. 1,21,000 at USMS (the on-campus university school) to Rs. 1,80,000 at top private colleges like NDIM. Most affiliated colleges sit between Rs. 95,000 and Rs. 1,30,000 per year. Add university charges (exam + infrastructure + alumni + innovation) of approximately Rs. 25,000-Rs. 35,500 per year on top. Fees are capped by the 6th SFRC Delhi Gazette Notification dated 14.07.2025.

mainEntity.name: Which IPU BBA college has the lowest fees in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: USMS (University School of Management Studies, on the GGSIPU Dwarka campus) has the lowest BBA tuition at Rs. 1,21,000 per year &mdash; but admission requires a Delhi-region CUET rank inside the top 100. Among affiliated colleges, Tecnia (Rohini) and DSPSR (Rohini) are the most affordable at approximately Rs. 95,000 per year. mainEntity.name: Does IPU accept CUET (UG) score for admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Per Section 1.1 ("At a Glance") of the GGSIPU UG Admission Brochure 2026-27, CUET (marked with #) is the secondary admission pathway for B.Tech, BBA, B.Com Hons, BCA, BJMC, BMS, Integrated Law (BA-LLB / BBA-LLB), B.Pharm, BHMCT, B.Ed and most other UG programmes. Per Important Instruction #37, CUET is used to fill vacant seats after the National Level Test / IPU CET merit list is exhausted. CUET is not applicable for B.Arch (NATA), MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS (NEET UG) and BSc Hons Nursing.

mainEntity.name: Can I get a management quota seat at IPU using a CUET score?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Per Important Instruction #21 and Chapter 12, Note 2 of the brochure, a candidate seeking admission through management quota at any IPU self-financing affiliated college must have qualified the "notified National Level Test / GGSIPU CET 2026 / CUET or any other applicable entrance test". A valid CUET score therefore unlocks the 10% management seats reserved at every unaided affiliated college (MAIT, MSIT, BPIT, GTBIT, VIPS-TC, ADGITM, BVP, MAIMS, Echelon Faridabad and most others). Management quota does not apply to USS, minority-status, or government institutions.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to take both IPU CET and CUET (UG) for IPU admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should take both whenever practical. Per Instruction #37, IPU first allots seats to NLT/CET qualifiers; CUET-only candidates are considered against the seats that remain vacant. So your best chance is to clear the primary test (JEE Main for B.Tech, CLAT for Law, IPU CET for BBA/B.Com/BCA/BJMC) and CUET as a backup. Note: a candidate already admitted via NLT/CET cannot then take a CUET seat (Instruction #37, second sentence).

mainEntity.name: How do I register for CUET (UG) 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: CUET (UG) registration is independent of GGSIPU. Visit the official NTA CUET portal (cuet.nta.nic.in) when registration opens, create your candidate account, choose your Section IA language paper, your Section II domain subjects (PCM for B.Tech; Business Studies / Accountancy / Legal Studies / Economics etc. for non-engineering courses) and Section III General Aptitude Test if relevant, pay the fee and submit. After CUET results, register separately on ipu.admissions.nic.in for IPU CUET-based counselling.

mainEntity.name: Which IPU programmes do not accept CUET?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per the "At a Glance" table on pages 22-23 of the brochure: B.Arch (Code 100) uses only NATA; MBBS (103), BDS (104), BAMS (153), BHMS (154) use only NEET UG 2026; B.Sc. (Hons) Nursing (115) uses NEET UG + IPU CET; 3-year LLB (238), Lateral Entry to B.Tech (128/129) and Lateral Entry programmes use only IPU CET; D.Pharm (190) is admitted on Class 12 merit only.

mainEntity.name: Will GGSIPU notify a separate CUET counselling schedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Per Section 1.2 ("Admissions Through The Merit Of CUET") of the brochure: "the methodology for conduct of CUET may be as per the notification to be issued by the University in due course of time", and CUET-based admissions are "carried out after exhausting of merit of respective National Level Test / Common Entrance Tests conducted by the University". Watch ipu.ac.in and ipu.admissions.nic.in after the IPU CET / JEE Main result for the CUET-counselling notification.

mainEntity.name: Can I get BA Economics admission at IPU only with a CUET score?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through two routes. (1) Vacant-seat round: per Important Instruction #37, GGSIPU runs IPU CET counselling first; whatever BA Economics seats remain unfilled are then offered on CUET merit. (2) Management Quota: per Important Instruction #21 + Chapter 12, every unaided affiliated college reserves 10% seats as management quota where a valid CUET score is one of the accepted qualifiers. The candidate must still meet the Class 12 50% aggregate eligibility (best 4 including English).

mainEntity.name: Which CUET (UG) subject papers should I attempt for IPU BA Economics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 2, Programme Code 197 of the 2026-27 brochure, attempt: Section IA — English (Code 101), and at least one of Section II — Economics / Business Economics (Code 309) or Section II — Mathematics / Applied Mathematics (Code 319). Attempting all three gives the strongest profile. Commerce-stream students should prioritise Economics (309); Science-stream students should prioritise Mathematics (319).

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for BA Economics admission at IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pass in Class 12 of CBSE or equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks (best 4 subjects including English). Must have passed English (core/elective/functional) as a subject. Reserved category candidates get a 5% relaxation per university policy. Marks are not rounded off (Instruction #28).

mainEntity.name: Do I need Mathematics in Class 12 for BA Economics at IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Mathematics is not a mandatory Class 12 subject for BA Economics eligibility at IPU. The eligibility requires Class 12 pass with 50% aggregate (best 4 including English) — stream is not restricted. However, taking CUET Mathematics paper (Code 319) in addition to Economics (309) can strengthen your CUET profile for IPU BA Economics admission.

mainEntity.name: Which colleges offer BA Economics (Hons) at IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: USSHSS (University School of Humanities &amp; Social Sciences) at Dwarka is IPU's own school for BA Economics. A limited number of affiliated colleges also offer BA Economics under Programme Code 197. Check ipu.ac.in for the current year's participating college list.

mainEntity.name: Will GGSIPU notify a separate CUET counselling schedule for BA Economics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Per Section 1.2 of the brochure, CUET-based admissions are carried out after exhausting the IPU CET merit list. GGSIPU will publish a separate notification for CUET vacant-seat counselling. Watch ipu.ac.in and ipu.admissions.nic.in after the IPU CET result.

mainEntity.name: Can I get BBA admission at IPU only with a CUET score?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through two routes. (1) Vacant-seat round: per Important Instruction #37, GGSIPU runs IPU CET counselling first; whatever BBA seats remain unfilled are then offered on CUET merit. (2) Management Quota: per Important Instruction #21 + Chapter 12, every unaided affiliated BBA college (VIPS-TC, MAIMS, JIMS, BCIPS, CPJ etc.) reserves 10% seats as management quota where a valid CUET score is one of the accepted qualifiers. mainEntity.name: Which CUET (UG) subject papers should I attempt for IPU BBA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 2, Programme Code 125 of the 2026-27 brochure, attempt at least one of: Section IA — English (Code 101), Section II — Business Studies (Code 305), Section III — General Aptitude Test (Code 501). The strongest combination is all three. Candidates without Business Studies in Class 12 can use English + General Aptitude Test.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for BBA admission at IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pass in Class 12 of CBSE or equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks (best 4 subjects including English). mainEntity.name: Which IPU BBA colleges are most likely to have CUET vacant seats?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacant-seat availability changes year to year. Tier-2 colleges historically have more BBA seats remaining after IPU CET rounds — watch for CPJ College, DIST, Fairfield, Ideal Institute, DME Noida, JIMS Greater Noida and Tier-2 BBA-FIA / BBA-MOM specialisations at VIPS-TC. Top colleges (USMS, MAIMS general BBA) usually fill in IPU CET rounds.

mainEntity.name: How is the BBA aggregate calculated for management quota under CUET?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 12 of the brochure: "for programmes like BBA, BHMCT, BCA &amp; BA(JMC) for calculating aggregate marks obtained in the qualifying examination, aggregate marks of best 4 subjects should be taken which includes English." So for BBA management quota, the merit list is built on best-4 Class 12 marks (including English). The candidate must additionally have a valid IPU CET / JEE Main / CUET score per Instruction #21 — but the rank ordering uses Class 12 marks, not the entrance score.

mainEntity.name: Is the BBA fee different for CUET-admitted students?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — the fee is identical regardless of admission route. Per Chapter 14, USMS BBA-MBA Integrated tuition 2026-27 is Rs. 1,21,000 per annum (USS is not open to management quota). mainEntity.name: Which CUET (UG) subject papers should I attempt for IPU BCA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 2, Programme Code 114 of the 2026-27 brochure, attempt: Section IA — English (Code 101), Section II — Mathematics / Applied Mathematics (Code 319), Section II — Computer Science / Informatics Practices (Code 308), Section III — General Aptitude Test (Code 501). mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for BCA admission at IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pass in Class 12 of CBSE or equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks (best 4 subjects including English). mainEntity.name: Do I need Mathematics in Class 12 for BCA at IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Mathematics is not a mandatory Class 12 subject for BCA eligibility at IPU. The eligibility requires Class 12 pass with 50% aggregate (best 4 including English) — stream is not restricted. However, attempting both Mathematics (Code 319) and Computer Science/Informatics Practices (Code 308) in CUET (UG) strengthens your CUET profile for IPU BCA admission.

mainEntity.name: Which IPU BCA colleges are most likely to have CUET vacant seats?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacant-seat availability changes year to year. USICT (USS) usually fills in IPU CET rounds. Tier-2 affiliated colleges historically have more seats remaining after CET rounds — watch BVICAM, Fairfield, CPJ College, Ideal Institute and Don Bosco. Apply to multiple colleges to maximise chances.

mainEntity.name: What is the Computer Science subject code in CUET for IPU BCA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Computer Science / Informatics Practices is Code 308 under Section II of CUET (UG). Mathematics / Applied Mathematics is Code 319. Both are relevant domain papers for IPU BCA (Programme Code 114). Combining CS/Informatics (308) + Maths (319) + English (101) + General Aptitude (501) gives the strongest CUET profile for BCA vacant-seat and management quota admission at IPU.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through two routes. mainEntity.name: Which CUET (UG) subject papers should I attempt for IPU B.Com Hons?

mainEntity.name: Is B.Com Honours at IPU a 3-year or 4-year programme?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-2 colleges historically have more B.Com Hons seats remaining after IPU CET rounds. VIPS-TC, MAIMS and USMS top sections usually fill in IPU CET rounds.

mainEntity.name: Is the B.Com Hons fee different for CUET-admitted students?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — the fee is identical regardless of admission route. Per Chapter 14, USMS B.Com Hons tuition 2026-27 is Rs. 1,21,000 per annum (USS is not open to management quota). (1) Vacant-seat round: per Important Instruction #37, GGSIPU runs IPU CET counselling first; whatever BJMC seats remain unfilled are then offered on CUET merit. (2) Management Quota: per Important Instruction #21 + Chapter 12, every unaided affiliated BJMC college (VIPS-TC, JIMS, MAIMS, CPJ etc.) reserves 10% seats as management quota where a valid CUET score is one of the accepted qualifiers. The candidate must still meet the Class 12 50% aggregate eligibility (best 4 including English).

mainEntity.name: Which CUET (UG) subject papers should I attempt for IPU BJMC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 2, Programme Code 126 of the 2026-27 brochure, attempt at least one of: Section IA — English (Code 101), Section II — Mass Media &amp; Mass Communication (Code 318), Section III — General Aptitude Test (Code 501). The strongest combination is all three. Candidates who did not study Mass Communication in Class 12 can use English + General Aptitude Test.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for BJMC / BA(JMC) admission at IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pass in Class 12 of CBSE or equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks (best 4 subjects including English). Must have passed English (core/elective/functional) as a subject. Reserved category candidates get a 5% relaxation per university policy. Marks are not rounded off (Instruction #28).

mainEntity.name: What is the Mass Media subject code in CUET for IPU BJMC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mass Media &amp; Mass Communication is Code 318 under Section II of CUET (UG). This is the domain-specific subject paper relevant to BA(JMC) / BJMC. Combined with Section IA English (101) and Section III General Aptitude Test (501), this gives the strongest CUET profile for IPU BJMC vacant-seat and management quota counselling.

mainEntity.name: Which IPU BJMC colleges are most likely to have CUET vacant seats?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacant-seat availability changes year to year. USMC (USS) usually fills in IPU CET rounds. Tier-2 affiliated colleges historically have more seats remaining after CET rounds — watch VIPS-TC, JIMS, MAIMS, CPJ College and Bharati Vidyapeeth. Apply to multiple colleges to maximise chances.

mainEntity.name: Will GGSIPU notify a separate CUET counselling schedule for BJMC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Per Section 1.2 of the brochure, CUET-based admissions are carried out after exhausting the IPU CET merit list. GGSIPU will publish a separate notification for CUET vacant-seat counselling. Watch ipu.ac.in and ipu.admissions.nic.in after the IPU CET result.

mainEntity.name: Can I get B.Tech admission at IPU only with a CUET score (without JEE Main)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through two routes. (1) Vacant-seat round: per Important Instruction #37, GGSIPU runs JEE Main counselling first; whatever B.Tech seats remain unfilled are then offered on CUET merit through additional rounds. (2) Management Quota: per Important Instruction #21 + Chapter 12, every unaided affiliated B.Tech college (MAIT/MSIT/BPIT/GTBIT/BVP/ADGITM/Echelon etc.) reserves 10% seats as management quota where a valid CUET score is one of the accepted qualifiers. The candidate must still meet the Class 12 PCM 55% eligibility.

mainEntity.name: Which CUET (UG) subject papers should I attempt for IPU B.Tech?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 2, Programme Code 131 of the 2026-27 brochure, attempt: Section II — Physics (Code 322), Section II — Mathematics / Applied Mathematics (Code 319), and Section II — Chemistry (Code 306) or Computer Science / Informatics Practices (Code 308) for CSE/IT/AI majors. Add Section IA — English (Code 101) as the language paper. Final paper-mapping is notified by GGSIPU before counselling per Section 1.2 of the brochure.

mainEntity.name: Will GGSIPU conduct its own engineering CET in 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Per Chapter 2, Programme Code 131: "All applicants are required to appear in Joint Entrance Exam (JEE) Main Paper 1 Conducted by National Testing Agency (NTA). The University shall not conduct its own CET for admissions, but shall be utilizing the merit of JEE Main Paper 1 for its admissions." CUET (UG) is the secondary admission pathway used only to fill seats remaining vacant after JEE Main counselling.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for B.Tech admission at IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pass in Class 12 of CBSE or equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 55% in Physics, Chemistry &amp; Mathematics (PCM), provided the candidate has passed in each subject separately. The candidate must additionally have passed English as a subject (core/elective/functional). Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC/PwD) get a 5% relaxation to 50%. Marks are not rounded off (Instruction #28). Blind, deaf or dumb candidates are not eligible for B.Tech per the Chapter 2 footnote.

mainEntity.name: Which IPU colleges are most likely to have CUET vacant seats for B.Tech?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacant-seat availability changes year to year, but Tier-2 and Tier-3 affiliated colleges historically have more seats remaining after the JEE Main rounds. Watch for openings at BVP Paschim Vihar, DIST, Echelon Faridabad, JEMTEC Greater Noida, GTBIT specialisations beyond CSE, and HMR IT&amp;M. Top USS (USICT/USAR) and MAIT-tier seats usually fill in JEE Main rounds, so plan with realistic college-rank targets.

mainEntity.name: Is the B.Tech fee different for CUET-admitted students?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The fee is identical regardless of admission route. Per Chapter 14, USS B.Tech fee 2026-27 is Rs. 2,04,900 in Year 1 (tuition Rs. 1,69,400 + Rs. 35,500 university/exam/infra/alumni charges). Affiliated colleges charge Rs. 1,60,100-1,65,770 in year-1 tuition per their 2026-27 fee notices (the 14.07.2025 SFRC gazette range was Rs. 1,41,750 to Rs. 1,55,700). Management quota seats at the same colleges follow the same regulated fee — be cautious of any agent quoting higher.

mainEntity.name: Can I get Integrated Law (BA-LLB / BBA-LLB) admission at IPU only with a CUET score?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through two routes for the 5-year Integrated Law programme (Code 121). (1) Vacant-seat round: per Important Instruction #37, GGSIPU runs CLAT UG 2026 counselling first; whatever Law seats remain unfilled are then offered on CUET merit. (2) Management Quota: per Important Instruction #21 + Chapter 12, every unaided affiliated Law college reserves 10% seats as management quota where a valid CUET score is one of the accepted qualifiers. Note: the 3-year LLB programme (Code 238) is admitted only through IPU CET — CUET does not apply for 3-year LLB.

mainEntity.name: Which CUET (UG) subject papers should I attempt for IPU Law?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 2, Programme Code 121 of the 2026-27 brochure, attempt: Section IA — English (Code 101), Section II — Legal Studies, Section III — General Aptitude Test (Code 501). English is mandatory since BCI requires English as a Class 12 subject. Legal Studies is the most directly aligned domain paper. General Aptitude Test overlaps with CLAT prep — analytical reasoning, current affairs, quantitative reasoning.

mainEntity.name: I did Class 12 through NIOS / Open Schooling — am I eligible for IPU Law?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Per Chapter 2 of the brochure quoting BCI Letter BCI:D:1823/2010 (LE) dated 31.11.2010: "The applicants who have obtained 10+2 or graduation/post graduation through Open Universities system directly without having any basic qualification for prosecuting such students are not eligible for admission in the law courses." This bar applies to all Integrated Law admissions at IPU regardless of CLAT, CUET or management-quota route. NIOS / Open School candidates with a regular pre-qualification (e.g. completed Class 10 from a regular Board first) may be eligible — confirm with the college before applying.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Programme Code 121 and Programme Code 238?

acceptedAnswer.text: Code 121 is the 5-year Integrated Law programme (BA-LLB Hons / BA-LLB / BBA-LLB Hons / BBA-LLB) entered after Class 12 — admission via CLAT (primary) + CUET (vacant-seat/management quota). Code 238 is the 3-year LLB programme entered after graduation — admission only via GGSIPU CET 2026 (CUET does not apply). See the dedicated Law (3-Year) admission page for full Code 238 details. Eligibility for Code 238: graduation in any discipline with 50% marks; reserved category relaxation per university policy.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility for Integrated Law admission at IPU 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pass in Class 12 of CBSE or equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks* (best 4 subjects including English) and must also have passed English (core/elective/functional) as a subject. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC/PwD) get 5% relaxation. Marks are not rounded off (Instruction #28). BCI bar applies — Open School candidates without basic qualification are not eligible regardless of admission route.

mainEntity.name: Is the Integrated Law fee different for CUET-admitted students?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — the fee is identical regardless of admission route. Per Chapter 14, USLLS BA-LLB / BBA-LLB tuition 2026-27 is Rs. 1,45,200 per annum (USS is not open to management quota). Affiliated Law colleges typically charge Rs. 1,30,000-1,55,000 per year tuition per the 6th SFRC notification dated 14.07.2025, plus university and welfare charges. Management quota seats follow the same regulated fee — capitation fee is illegal under the Delhi Professional Colleges Act, 2007.

mainEntity.name: What is Programme Code 238 at GGSIPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Programme Code 238 is the LLB (Three Years) Programme at GGSIPU — a 3-year Bachelor of Laws degree for candidates who have already completed graduation. Per the GGSIPU UG Admission Brochure 2026-27 (Chapter 2, Sr. No. 35), admission is exclusively through the GGSIPU CET 2026. CUET is NOT accepted for this programme.

mainEntity.name: Who is eligible for Law (3-Year) admission at IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 2 of the brochure: "The candidate must have passed graduation in any discipline with 50% marks from a recognized University or Institutions recognized by University/UGC/Governments." Reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/PwD) get relaxation per the brochure. Marks are not rounded off. Open School candidates without a basic qualification are barred per BCI Letter BCI:D:1823/2010 dated 31.11.2010.

mainEntity.name: Which entrance test is required for Programme Code 238?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only the GGSIPU CET 2026 conducted by Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University. The CET paper has three sections: Language &amp; Comprehension 25%, General Knowledge &amp; Current Affairs 25%, Basic Understanding of Law and Legal Reasoning 50%. Admission is on the basis of Common Merit Rank (CML) drawn from this CET.

mainEntity.name: Is CUET accepted for the 3-year LLB at IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Per Section 1.1 and Chapter 2 of the GGSIPU UG Admission Brochure 2026-27, the "Domain Specific Subjects under CUET 2026" column is blank for Programme Code 238. CUET, CLAT and other national-level law tests do NOT apply to the 3-year LLB at IPU. The only pathway is GGSIPU CET 2026.

mainEntity.name: What is the fee structure for IPU Law (3-Year) 2026-27?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per Chapter 14 (Section 14.1 (F)) of the GGSIPU PG Admission Brochure 2026-27: USLLS USS tuition for 3-year LLB is Rs. 1,45,200 per annum for A.Y. 2026-27 (Total Year 1: Rs. 1,80,700 including university charges, exam fee, alumni and infrastructure components). Year 2: Rs. 1,93,220. Year 3: Rs. 2,09,192. Affiliated colleges charge as per the 6th SFRC notification F.No. DHE.18(1)/6th SFRC/2023/3205-15 dated 14th July 2025, plus university and welfare charges.

mainEntity.name: Which colleges offer the 3-year LLB under IPU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The University School of Law and Legal Studies (USLLS, Dwarka campus) is the on-campus USS option for Programme Code 238. Affiliated colleges that have offered the 3-year LLB in past admission cycles include VIPS-TC Pitampura, MAIMS, BCIPS, Fairfield, Ideal Institute, DME Noida, CPJ Narela and BVP Paschim Vihar. Final 2026-27 intake per college is per Chapter 13 of the brochure — verify before locking counselling preferences.

mainEntity.name: How is the 3-year LLB different from the 5-year Integrated BA-LLB / BBA-LLB?

acceptedAnswer.text: Code 238 (3-year LLB) is a graduate-entry programme: requires bachelor degree + 50%, admission only via GGSIPU CET, duration 3 years. Code 121 (5-year Integrated BA-LLB / BBA-LLB) is a Class-12-entry programme: requires 10+2 with 50% (best of 4 incl. English), admission via CLAT (primary) + CUET (vacant-seat), duration 5 years. Both lead to BCI-recognised LLB enrolment subject to BCI rules.

mainEntity.name: What are IPU 3-year LLB fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: At USLLS (the university school), 3-year LLB tuition is Rs. 1,45,200 in year 1, Rs. 1,93,220 in year 2 and Rs. 2,09,192 in year 3, about Rs. 5.48 lakh in total (PG Brochure 2026-27, Section 14.1(F)). Affiliated colleges have their own SFRC-regulated fees. See the IPU fee structure.

— primary national-level test conducted by the Consortium of NLUs. Candidates with CLAT scores fill seats first through centralised GGSIPU counselling.

— vacant-seat fallback per Important Instruction #37. CUET-qualified candidates fill any remaining seats after CLAT counselling exhausts. CUET also qualifies you for the 10% Management Quota at unaided affiliated Law colleges per Chapter 12.
